notes.title: Mushihimesama V1.1.9.2 update released
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Detail[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for frame rate drop after score upload[/list]

This patch fixes a problem some players were experiencing whereby after playing on Score Attack mode and uploading a score, the game would slow down throughout.

As always, if you still experience this problem after updating, please tell us [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/377860/discussions/0/496880503063311873]here[/url] or by commenting here.

For owners of Deathsmiles, that has been [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/314180/announcements/detail/541951382554375106]updated[/url] too.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/314180

notes.title: Mushihimesama V1.1.8.0 Update - Score Registration Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]Mushihimesama V1.1.8.0 - 12/22/2015[/h1]
Corrected an error where continue scores were incorrectly registered to leaderboard.

Some scores presenting this bug were removed from the leaderboards in order to restore the correct score ordering.  We apologize if there is any inconvenience from this.

notes.title: Mushihimesama V1.1.6.1 Update - Support For Vertical Aspect Ratios
notes.notes:
[h1]Mushihimesama V1.1.6.1 - 12/15/2015[/h1]
[list][*]Optimizations to reduce or eliminate microstuttering/frame hitching.
[*]Corrected a visual error that would cause the true last boss health bar to display incorrectly in V1.5 Ultra mode.
[*]Added support for fullscreen tate (vertical aspect ratios) on 3:4 and 9:16 monitors.  You can adjust this using the "Aspect Ratio" setting.  Support for 16:10, 5:4, 4:5, and 10:16 aspect ratios is planned for a future update.
[*]Added a dead zone setting for direct input controllers (joystick adjustment).
[*]Modified the Replay menu to show local replays and replays downloaded from the leaderboards in different colors.[/list]
